turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want a better bedtime routine. Right now I just scroll until I pass out.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A wind down routine can really help. What would you enjoy doing in the last half hour instead, reading, stretching, or maybe a warm shower?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a second, my roommate wants to ask me something. I'll let you know when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Jordan, did you finish the milk?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There should be a little left, check behind the juice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Found it. Barely enough for one coffee.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Make it for yourself. I'll grab one on the way to work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you sure? I can share it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, really. There's a new place near the station I want to try anyway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were building your bedtime routine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Reading. I've got a pile of books I never touch.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect. Leave the phone charging in another room and keep a book on your pillow.
